Subject: Procurement intake & vendor setup - Acme Analytics

Hi Samantha -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your procurement team has what they need to get Redwood set up: 

Summary from the call:
- Use case: customer support triage + knowledge base augmentation (pilot for 3 months)
- Expected monthly spend: ~$12k during pilot (spikes possible during onboarding)
- Data residency: US only

Procurement / commercial path items we discussed (please confirm):
1) Payment method: will you be issuing a PO (preferred) or do you want to pay by card? If PO, please confirm billing address and PO contact.
2) Vendor onboarding: do you use a vendor portal or do you prefer emailed vendor packet + DocuSign?
3) Required tax forms: W-9 (US) vs W-8 (if non-US entity) - happy to provide the correct form.
4) Banking details: we can provide bank details / ACH form or accept card.

Attached for your procurement team: vendor_setup_packet.pdf (stub) - includes company info, primary contacts, sample SOW language, and standard Redwood billing info.

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm PO vs card and the procurement contact + portal link (if applicable).
- Me: send W-9 and bank details / vendor packet and a DocuSign link if that's easiest.
- Once the vendor packet is received, your team can complete vendor setup and approve first PO.

If it helps, I can loop in our finance lead (Monica Patel) to answer any invoice / payment-platform questions - cc'd.

Thanks - happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if that speeds things up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: vendor_setup_packet.pdf (attachment stub)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming procurement requirements on our side: 
- For pilot deals over $5k we require a PO (we will route PO internally to Accounts Payable).
- We use a vendor portal for vendor onboarding: https://acme-analytics.vendorportal.com. I've CC'd procurement; please send the vendor packet and W-9.
- Procurement will need: W-9, company address, remit-to/bank details, and a primary billing contact.
- Standard payment terms are Net 30 from invoice receipt.

DocuSign is acceptable if you prefer - we also accept emailed PDFs if that's easier. I don't expect additional SOC documents for the pilot; we can circle back if needed.

Procurement contact: Priya Nair (procurement@acme-analytics.com) - she can open the vendor request in the portal.

Can you send the W-9 and bank details today? We aim to have a PO issued by end of week so we can kick off next week.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Partnerships | Acme Analytics
